editorial.blurb: A nostalgic Cantonese spot with red booths and wallet-friendly prices, delivering crispy egg rolls and tender meat dishes that hit the mark for casual neighborhood dining.
editorial.insiderTip: Order takeout for piping hot food ready in about 10 minutes, or go for lunch when the Curry Chicken and Hot and Sour Soup shine—just give yourself time to decide and arrive early to find parking.
